description: Clean-room SandTie H3 kinetic choreography vocabulary built with skeletal joint phrasing and natural soft-tissue motion.

pacing_rules.motion_language: Describe smooth natural speed transitions ('glides gently', 'snaps crisply', 'rolls steadily') rather than numeric Hz values.
pacing_rules.anatomy_order: State bone, hip, and shoulder trajectory first, adding 'with natural soft-tissue movement' during drops or shimmies.
pacing_rules.orientation_lock: State initial body angle toward or away from camera in [Shot 1], keeping left/right hand placement concrete in every beat.

core_actions: figure-eight hip sway shifting weight smoothly left to right
vertical body wave rolling seamlessly from shoulders down through ribcage and hips
rhythmic chest pop accent followed by controlled torso release
slow 360-degree pivot turn planting heels cleanly on the final beat
controlled deep knee drop rising smoothly through the lower spine
upper_body_and_hands: fingertips gliding lightly along collarbone toward the jawline
both palms sweeping slowly behind hair and resting briefly at the nape
index finger tracing an unhurried beckon toward the lens
hands bracing lightly on waist/hips framing hip rotations
finales_and_poses: settles weight cleanly onto one hip with poised chin tilt and unbroken eye lock
turns three-quarters back over one shoulder holding a knowing smirk
steps smoothly toward the lens landing in an intimate chest-up hold
